<!-- pr-reviewer: 3cf74de74940bad5174c6c81373474c0cc4ed071 -->
Review of release PR #577 (chore(release): 0.16.0), head 3cf74de. Docs/version only; nothing built, merged, pushed or tagged.

**Checks that pass**
1. `origin/main` (b6516886) is an ancestor of `origin/release/v0.16.0`; main has not moved past the cut. MERGEABLE.
2. Changed files are exactly the expected set: CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, RECOMMENDED.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock (10 `camcraft` entries 0.15.0 → 0.16.0), and 56 `docs/decisions/*.md` removed. `docs/decisions/README.md` is kept.
3. RELEASE_NOTES.md: 0.16.0 is first, the `---` separator is at line 96, BREAKING leads, the project format is v58 (`PROJECT_VERSION = 58` in crates/app/src/project/file.rs), Known issues are listed and all five are OPEN (#554, #330, #558, #523, #74), and the contributors (mkinney, seelesturm, austin62jake, tbrasselle) match the authors of the changelog PRs.
4. CHANGELOG.md: 54 rows in the required format; all 54 shas are in origin/main; 54 distinct PRs, no duplicate PR rows; every row is a feat or fix.
5. No closing keywords in the PR title, body or commit messages.
6. RECOMMENDED.md has the `## v0.16.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` heading (line 17204).

**Blocker: an inaccurate BREAKING note (RELEASE_NOTES.md, first paragraph)**
The note says "the Tormach and Siemens 840D posts now ... refuse a machine that states none (#495, #503)". That is wrong for Tormach. `assets/posts/tormach.cps` `safeZ()` keeps the PathPilot Z0 when the machine name is a Tormach model (`/^\s*tormach\b/i`) and stating no safe_retract. Only a non-Tormach machine that states none is refused. The Siemens 840D post does refuse every named machine that states none, so that half is correct. The shipped Tormach files all state `safe_retract: 0.0`, so no built-in machine is refused.

Suggested wording: "the Tormach posts retract to the machine file's `safe_retract`, and refuse a non-Tormach machine that states none; the Siemens 840D post refuses any machine that states none (#495, #503)." Fix it on this branch and push (plain push), then re-gate the docs change.

**Nit (not a blocker)**
- Known issues: "Pixel snapshot goldens are release-lane tests (#359)". #359 is MERGED, so it is not a known issue. Drop the line or reword it as a release-process note.

**Verdict:** needs-rework (one blocker: the Tormach wording in a BREAKING note). This PR was already flagged ready, so it is turned back into a draft (AGENTS.md "Draft PRs"). Flag it ready again after the fix is pushed and re-checked.

Fixed both review points in e02cfce3 (docs only): the BREAKING note now says the Tormach posts refuse only a non-Tormach machine with no `safe_retract`, while the Siemens 840D post refuses any machine without it; the #359 line is dropped from Known issues.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e02cfce3b2180bd8fd8360352b5c0eef35cd4f05 -->
Delta re-check of head e02cfce3 against 3cf74de7. Clean.

- Diff touches only RELEASE_NOTES.md (4 insertions, 5 deletions). The `---` separator before `# CamCraft 0.15.0` is intact.
- BREAKING wording now matches the posts: Tormach refuses only a non-Tormach machine that states no `safe_retract` (a Tormach model with none keeps Z0, per `assets/posts/tormach.cps` safeZ()); Siemens 840D refuses any named machine that states none (`assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` safeZ()).
- Known-issues line citing #359 removed.
- `origin/main` is an ancestor of `origin/release/v0.16.0`.

Verdict: merge-ready.

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
Covers the agent runs dispatched from the maintainer's session; a contributor's own authoring cost isn't visible and isn't included.
